title: Thermal Imaging Camera

onscreen_lines.desc: Thermal Imaging Camera – Bullard QXT Pro or Approved Equivalent New, unused thermal imaging camera suitable for firefighting and search-and-rescue operations. Reference product: Bullard QXT Pro; see attached manufacturer manual for product details. Provide pricing per camera and identify all included accessories, batteries, and charging equipment. Unit pricing shall include all shipping, handling, and delivery charges. Equivalent products are subject to City review and approval. Bidders shall identify the proposed manufacturer and model, upload supporting specifications, and clearly disclose any differences from the reference product. Include available manufacturer warranty information, operating and maintenance manuals, and anticipated delivery timeframe after receipt of a purchase order.
onscreen_lines.note: Quantity: Up to three (3). The City anticipates purchasing one (1) to three (3) cameras, depending on pricing and available funding. Final quantity will be determined at award.
